checks.rule: Profiles keep the original baseline and explicit comparison caps
checks.input: Read all four validated built-in profiles.
checks.expected: Original120/180, balanced150/200, fast180/220 mph; reference98.3m/s. All immutable.

checks.rule: Custom tuning is isolated from caller mutation and other vehicles
checks.input: Construct from mutable curve arrays; mutate source and try to mutate result.
checks.expected: Independent frozen copies; no mutation of built-ins.

checks.rule: Fingerprints identify physical settings, independent of labels and property order
checks.input: Same settings with different labels/ids; change a curve value by one tiny amount.
checks.expected: Cosmetic renaming keeps identity; any numeric tuning change produces a new identity.

checks.rule: Malformed settings are rejected at the configuration boundary
checks.input: NaN/Infinity, wrong types, missing curve origin, descending/duplicate speeds, negative forces, unknown settings, invalid caps, unvalidated objects.
checks.expected: Every malformed profile fails without changing any built-in.

checks.rule: Acceleration and grip curves are continuous, bounded and match supplied reference points
checks.input: Sweep0–120m/s in0.001m/s increments and query every knot.
checks.expected: No overshoot/nonfinite/negative values; C1-smooth joins and exact target knots.

checks.rule: High-speed wheel angles follow wheelbase and available sideways acceleration
checks.expected: At25m/s and above angle=atan(L*a/v²), capped30degrees. Wet has less lock; known-radius demands obey v²/r.

checks.rule: The profile/math layer has no browser dependencies and passes strict TypeScript
checks.expected: Strict compile passes without DOM libraries.
